children: Saudi master developer ROSHN said it is offering properties to non-Saudi buyers in three projects across three major cities.
These projects include SEDRA (Riyadh), ALAROUS (Jeddah) and ALMANAR (Makkah).
Thousands of non-Saudi buyers have registered interest since the regulatory updates, the developer, backed by the Public Investment Fund, said in a statement.
In July, Saudi Arabia introduced a comprehensive regulatory framework governing property ownership by non-Saudis.
Saudi Properties, the Kingdom’s official digital gateway, offers qualified buyers access to real estate opportunities across the Kingdom. Purchases can be made via the ROSHN App.
ROSHN said the move creates an opportunity to broaden access to its growing portfolio and support a larger, more dynamic real estate market over the long term.

title: PIF-backed ROSHN lists projects open for non-Saudi buyers
